_README: Pendo Predict POT — Customer Configuration Template. Fill this out per customer to map their SFDC/Pendo schema to the dashboard queries. See query_templates.sql for how each field is used.

sfdc._doc: Maps the customer's Salesforce schema to the concepts the POT queries need.

objects._doc: Which SFDC objects hold the data we need. Most customers use Opportunity, but some use a custom Renewal object.

fields._doc: Column/field names in the customer's SFDC for each concept. These get substituted directly into queries.

arr._doc: The field that holds annual recurring revenue. Could live on Account or Opportunity.
_transform_examples: Amount / Contract_Term_Months__c * 12 — calculate ARR from total and term
Account.ARR__c — field lives on Account, not Opportunity

close_date._doc: The date the renewal/churn was decided. Used for time-series grouping.

renewal_date._doc: The upcoming renewal date for open renewals. May be the same as close_date or a custom field.

stage._doc: The field that indicates the outcome of the opportunity.

currency_iso_code._doc: The currency code field on each Opportunity. Used to convert all $ amounts to USD via the SFDC CurrencyType table. Only relevant for multi-currency orgs.

filters._doc: Conditions that identify renewals vs. new business, and churns vs. successful renewals.

is_renewal._doc: SQL condition that identifies renewal records (as opposed to new biz, upsell, etc.)

is_closed._doc: SQL condition for closed (decided) opportunities — both wins and losses.

is_churn._doc: SQL condition that specifically identifies a churn/loss within closed renewals.

is_renewal_won._doc: SQL condition that identifies a successful renewal (not churned).

is_open_renewal._doc: SQL condition for upcoming/open renewals (not yet decided).

exclude_conditions._doc: Optional SQL conditions to exclude junk data (test accounts, $0 opps, etc.)

time_windows._doc: How far back to look for historical data and how far forward for upcoming renewals.

pendo._doc: Maps Pendo data to SFDC accounts. Table and column names vary by query editor instance — CE fills these in, not the customer.

account_mapping._doc: How Pendo subscriptions/accounts map to SFDC Account IDs.
_match_examples: Account.Pendo_Account_ID__c — custom field on Account holding Pendo ID
Account.Id — Pendo uses the SFDC Account ID directly

tables._doc: CE-provided: table names available in the Predict query editor. Check the editor's schema browser for exact names.

columns._doc: CE-provided: column names in the Pendo tables. Check the editor's schema browser for exact names.

_event_type_values._doc: The string values in the event_type column. Defaults shown; override if the schema uses different labels.

data_source._doc: Where Pendo data is accessed from.

dashboard_overrides._doc: Optional manual overrides for dashboard values that can't be queried automatically.
